 Binance New Listing: AXIS’s Alpha Debut Meets Remittix’s November 24 Countdown and Planned 20% Supply Cut
 Written by 
 Priya 
 Read time 
 3 min 
 Published 
 28 Oct 2026 
 Filed under 
 Cryptocurrency 
 Add to Preferred Sources 
 On this page
 Binance New Listing Momentum Can Move Quickly 
 A Supply Cut Arrives Beside Real Product Funnels 
 November Has the Ingredients for Violent Price Discovery 
 Axis Robotics made its Binance Alpha debut on October 21, with eligible users able to claim an AXIS airdrop through Alpha Points. Early access, incentives and limited liquidity created rapid price discovery around the launch. Binance New Listing speculation again shows how distribution can transform a little-known token into an immediate trading event.
 Remittix has fixed November 24 for its own public debut, but its setup includes a stronger tokenomic trigger: 300 million RTX will be permanently burned at launch. AXIS used an airdrop to widen ownership. Remittix will reduce supply 20% precisely as public access and product demand begin expanding.
 Binance New Listing Momentum Can Move Quickly
 Binance Alpha gives users early access to projects before any broader exchange pathway develops. The AXIS campaign required a minimum Alpha Points balance and offered a fixed token claim, encouraging users to compete for limited rewards and trade as soon as the market opened.
 That structure concentrates attention into a short period. Airdrop recipients may sell, new buyers may chase momentum and thin early liquidity can magnify both directions. The debut demonstrates why launch mechanics matter as much as a project’s long-term concept during the first hours of price discovery.
 Axis Robotics is tied to an emerging robotics and AI narrative, giving traders a recognisable theme. Its challenge is turning launch excitement into sustained usage and value capture after incentives fade. Exchange visibility can introduce a token, but revenue and token utility must keep buyers engaged.
 The Binance New Listing lesson is especially relevant to RTX. Remittix can enter public trading with scarcity, established presale distribution and several products capable of creating demand after launch-day speculation cools.
 A Supply Cut Arrives Beside Real Product Funnels
 Remittix PayFi converts crypto into fiat paid directly to bank accounts. The recipient does not need an exchange, allowing the service to attack expensive remittance charges, weak foreign-exchange rates and long international settlement times through a familiar banking endpoint.
 Forty-one additional fiat currencies can give Remittix a much larger geographic footprint. More currencies unlock more payment corridors, and every completed transfer can produce revenue while expanding recognition among consumers and businesses outside crypto-native circles.
 Remittix Markets provides perpetual-futures trading and has already passed $50 million in volume. This matters because perpetuals create frequent fees and repeat engagement, potentially financing growth while PayFi scales more gradually across regulated banking routes.
 Earn will connect depositors with Aave, Morpho, Fluid and Maple Finance pools, including selected ETH, USDT and USDC opportunities up to 22% APY. Extra APY for RTX holders can turn depositors into long-term token buyers rather than temporary yield shoppers.
 At launch, 300 million RTX will disappear permanently. Revenue-funded buybacks and burns can extend that model, allowing payment, trading and deposit activity to shrink supply over time. The burn is therefore not isolated hype; it can become the opening move in a product-backed scarcity strategy.
 November Has the Ingredients for Violent Price Discovery
 Remittix has raised about $33 million from over 40,000 participants toward a $36 million cap. RTX remains $0.28 before the announced $0.46 final presale stage, creating a 64.3% planned step before open trading.
 Binance New Listing events show how quickly limited liquidity and concentrated attention can move tokens. RTX adds a much larger community, a scheduled supply destruction and several revenue narratives that can keep demand active beyond the first session.
 If November buyers compete for 20% fewer tokens while PayFi, Markets and Earn pull RTX into use, the first cycle could be far more aggressive than an ordinary Alpha debut. The presale is the final opportunity before that scarcity becomes visible to everyone.
